name: dashboard-shell
description: One responsive dashboard chrome: desktop rail + topbar, mobile sheet sidebar + bottom dock, both driven by a single `nav` prop. Slots for workspace switcher, user menu, topbar actions and a secondary column.
notes: Needs shadcn `sidebar` installed (it brings sheet + tooltip). No Convex, no env, no localStorage. Pair with full-width-toggle in the topbar `actions` slot, workspace-shell in `sidebarHeader`.
